comment: Hand-maintained decisions merged into coverage.json by scripts/update_coverage.py. Tiers not listed here are assigned by the rules in that script.

excluded.reason: CUDA custom-kernel builder; tornado-mlx targets the Metal backend, and TornadoVM already runs CUDA kernels natively
Custom Metal kernel builder rather than an operation; TornadoVM's JIT and prebuiltTask already cover user-written kernels
Autodiff and graph transforms take closures over MLX computations; they are not data-parallel library tasks
Autodiff and scheduling markers with no effect on values outside an MLX transform
PRNG key management; the random factories derive keys from a seed argument instead of exposing keys as tasks
